title: Asian Games: Classification-bound Alas Men fall short vs Chinese Taipei to cap preliminaries
summary: Alas Pilipinas Men capped their preliminary round campaign with a 25-21, 20-25, 17-25, 27-29 loss to Chinese Taipei, Tuesday at Park Arena Komaki.
